examples.en: Tomorrow is the school's anniversary, so we don't go to school.
I'm going out with my friends on the school anniversary.

examples.ko: 우리 학교 개교기념일은 시월 이십 일이에요.
examples.en: Our school's anniversary is on October 20th.
It's a pity that the school anniversary falls on a weekend.
Thanks to the school anniversary, the holiday got longer.
On the school anniversary, the library is closed too.

explain: 학교가 처음 세워진 날을 기념하는 날이에요. 날짜는 학교마다 달라요. 그날을 쉬는 날로 정한 학교도 있고 그렇지 않은 학교도 있어요.

phrases.en: The school is closed because it's the school anniversary.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학교가 쉬는 이유를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to give the reason the school is closed.
phrases.en_equiv: to be off for the school anniversary

phrases.en: I slept in on the school anniversary.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그날 한 일을 말할 때 조사 '에'를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add the particle 에 to talk about what you did that day.

phrases.en: Our school's anniversary is in May.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학교마다 날짜가 다르므로 앞에 학교를 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: The date differs by school, so the school is named first.

explain_en: It is the day that marks when a school was founded. The date is different for each school. Some schools make it a day off and some don't.

examples.en: The assignment is due by tomorrow.

examples.ko: 과제물이 너무 많아서 주말에도 쉬지 못해요.
examples.en: There are so many assignments that I can't rest even on weekends.
I emailed my assignment to the professor.
When is the assignment deadline?
I forgot to write my name on the assignment.
I stayed up all night yesterday because of an assignment.

explain: 초등학생이 하는 것은 보통 '숙제'라고 해요. '과제물'은 대학이나 수업에서 내는 보고서나 결과물에 더 잘 어울려요. 줄여서 '과제'라고도 많이 말해요.

phrases.en: This week's assignment is writing a report.
phrases.nuance_ko: '과제물'을 줄인 말로 일상에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A shortened form of 과제물, used more often in daily speech.

phrases.en: I handed in my homework by email.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when submitting to a teacher or professor.

phrases.en: I have to submit my homework by Friday.

explain_en: For younger students, '숙제' is the usual word. '과제물' suits reports and work handed in for college or other classes. People often shorten it to '과제'.

examples.en: The app has a bug, so it keeps shutting down.
The developer fixed the bug yesterday.
This game has too many bugs.
If you find a bug, please let us know.
The bug is gone in the new version.
Because of a bug, my score wasn't saved.

explain: 버그는 프로그램이나 게임에서 생기는 오류를 말해요. '버그가 나다', '버그를 고치다'처럼 써요. 벌레라는 뜻의 영어에서 왔지만 한국어에서 벌레를 말할 때는 '벌레'를 써요.

phrases.en: A bug suddenly occurred while I was playing the game.
phrases.nuance_ko: 프로그램에 오류가 생겼다는 뜻으로 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it to say that an error appeared in a program.

phrases.en: I found a bug while testing.
phrases.nuance_ko: 개발이나 테스트에서 오류를 발견할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when finding errors in development or testing.

phrases.example: 버그를 발견하면 고객센터에 버그 신고를 해 주세요.
phrases.en: If you find a bug, please send a bug report to customer service.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앱이나 게임의 오류를 알릴 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing used when reporting errors in an app or game.

explain_en: 버그 is an error in a program or a game. It is used as '버그가 나다' and '버그를 고치다'. It comes from the English word for an insect, but for real insects Korean uses '벌레'.

examples.en: The one who is always late in our class is Minsu.
I ended up being a latecomer again today.
The teacher made the latecomers clean the classroom.
Latecomers, please come in through the front door.
These days the number of latecomers has dropped a lot.

examples.ko: 지각생에서 벗어나려고 일찍 일어나는 연습을 해요.
examples.en: I am practicing getting up early to stop being the latecomer.

explain: 주로 학교에서 쓰는 말이고, 지각을 자주 하는 학생을 가리켜요. 친구끼리는 놀리는 말투로도 쓰니까 어른에게는 '지각을 자주 하시는 분'처럼 돌려 말하는 게 좋아요. '지각하다'가 동사예요.

phrases.en: Minsu is a student who is late often.
phrases.nuance_ko: '지각생'을 풀어서 말한 표현이라 놀리는 느낌이 없어요.
phrases.nuance_en: A plain description of 지각생 without the teasing tone.
phrases.en_equiv: a student who is often late

phrases.example: 우리 팀에는 지각을 자주 하시는 분이 있어요.
phrases.en: There is someone on our team who is often late.
phrases.nuance_en: A polite way to say this about an adult instead of 지각생.
phrases.en_equiv: a person who is often late (polite)

phrases.en: Because of the rain, there are a lot of latecomers today.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학교에서 늦게 온 학생이 여럿일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used at school when many students arrive late.

explain_en: It is mostly a school word for students who are often late. Friends also use it teasingly, so with adults it is better to say something like '지각을 자주 하시는 분'. The verb form is '지각하다'.

examples.en: I went to the store to buy my son's school uniform.
The uniform got too small, so I had a new one made.
School uniforms these days are comfortable and pretty.
The school uniform shop sells uniform sets.

examples.ko: 졸업식 날 학생복 차림으로 사진을 찍었어요.
examples.en: On graduation day, I took photos in my school uniform.
Please attach a name tag to the school uniform.

explain: 학교 학생이 입는 옷을 말하지만, 일상에서는 보통 '교복'이라고 더 자연스럽게 말해요. '학생복'은 '학생복 매장'처럼 옷을 파는 곳이나 상품을 말할 때 자주 써요.

phrases.en: From tomorrow I go to school wearing a uniform.
phrases.nuance_en: In daily speech 교복 sounds more natural than 학생복.

phrases.en: I bought a skirt at the school uniform shop.
phrases.nuance_ko: 옷을 파는 곳을 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when talking about a place that sells uniforms.

phrases.en: My younger sibling took a photo wearing a school uniform.
phrases.nuance_en: The most basic collocation, with 입다.

explain_en: It refers to clothes worn by students, but in daily life '교복' sounds more natural. '학생복' often appears when talking about shops or products, as in '학생복 매장'.
